sections.title: Right now
lines: Pregame build, kickoff Sun 12:00pm CT. Sold 46, 2,896 resting. Worst line -$36 (goal -$75).

sections.title: Lagging sides
lines: Lagging (75+ behind the leader): ATL by 1-6, ATL by 7-14, ATL by 15+, SF by 1-6, SF by 15+.
ATL by 1-6: 46 behind. Crowd is quiet here (1 traded).
ATL by 7-14: 46 behind. Crowd is quiet here (6 traded).
A price step needs 10 min with no fill and the crowd paying less.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A side gets a new batch when its resting drops under 25% of launch.
Gate open: worst line -$36 is better than -$100.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It trips if the worst line falls under -$150.
Paid balancing starts Sun 11:15am CT: worst line to -$75 by Sun 11:50am CT, up to $50.
At Sun 11:30am CT, if worst line is -$75 or better, paid balancing stops.
Kickoff Sun 12:00pm CT: the in-game engine takes over.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: price steps, new batches and paid balancing run by rule. It will not reprice for line moves or news.
